vulnerable_code:
users_router = APIRouter(prefix="/users", tags=["user-sessions"])

@users_router.delete("/{user_id}/sessions/{session_id}")
async def revoke_remote_session(
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    session_id: str,
    session_store: RedisSessionStore = Depends(get_session_store),
    current_user: User = Depends(current_active_user)
):
    session_key = f"user_session:{user_id}:{session_id}"
    exists = await session_store.exists(session_key)
    if not exists:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session token not found")

    await session_store.delete(session_key)
    return {"status": "revoked", "session_id": session_id}
diagnosis: The endpoint revokes an active session key in the session store based on user_id and session_id from the URL path. Because it fails to confirm that current_user.id matches user_id or that current_user is an administrator, an attacker can terminate active user sessions and cause denial of service for other users.
